question: Which deity and life-giving function are assigned to the syllable ka?
premises: The syllable ka is named as the subject.
Varuṇa is declared as its deity.
Varuṇa is the maker of the world's life-force.
inference: The syllable ka corresponds to Varuṇa as the cause of the world's vital breath.
plain_english: The syllable ka is declared to be Varuṇa, the maker of the life-force of the world.
